name: remediation-recommendation-planner
description: Produce lightweight, approval-aware remediation recommendations from observability and runbook evidence.

# Remediation Recommendation Planner

1. Propose remediation options only; do not execute changes.
2. Prioritize low-risk, reversible actions first.
3. Include risk, blast radius, and rollback notes per action.
4. Provide a clear operator approval checklist.
